story.zh: 曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...
story.en: With an army of a million men bearing down on Jiangdong, Cao Cao constructed a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilled his forces day and night. Liu Bei followed his strategist's advice and joined forces with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.

forbidden.zh: 主角是庞统时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.
